poster.purpose: The one word on an opening, problem, solution, demand or closing slide.

headline.purpose: One line per data slide, shrunk to fit.

figure.purpose: Key numbers; counts up when the page opens.

technical.purpose: Timecodes, call IDs, track names, units, arrow labels, slide numbers.

shadows.name: key
shadows.purpose: Under the pink yes key on posters.

breakpoints.name: touch
breakpoints.value: 900px: presenter buttons hide, the tape centres

components.name: Segment switch
components.description: Chart switch; the selected option is an ink knob.

components.name: Yes key
components.description: The pink key that marks the caller's yes on posters.

components.name: Section cues
components.description: Top-rail sections; the current one carries a 3px pink cue.

narrative.northStar: A call recording you can play
narrative.overview: Every slide sits on Placet's own two-track format: agent above a centre line, customer below, pink for the yes. Posters are the call on plum-black; data slides are the archive on white.
keyCharacteristics: Pink playhead transition with a section flag
Rounded bar marks shared by speech and charts
One family, Host Grotesk 500; Geist Mono only for technical text

rules.name: The record light rule
rules.body: Pink appears once per view, on the thing the presenter is pointing at.

rules.name: Losses are plum
rules.body: Negative values use loss plum below the centre line.

rules.name: No eyebrows
rules.body: Page labels live in the running foot, never above a heading.

dos: Keep a legend for two-series charts
Keep every figure in the ₹/$ switch
Let one moment move per slide
donts: No kickers or section numbers above headings
No violet, gradients or glowing text
